item.content:encoded: So you'd like to make a little cheese? Stack some lettuce? Grab some dough? Well it's easier than you think. You might have guessed there are a few things you need to do first. Let me be clear on something, I'm not offering to pay you to post on my site (not today anyway). What I am offering is a chance to use this website as a chance to showcase your designs or designs you could get a commission on - for FREE. So first you must have either a website of your own that sells nerdy products, or be an affiliate for a nerdy product that is not already on here. If you don't know what these are, do some googling. You can head over to cj.com (Commission Junction) and sign up free to get links to products to promote and get paid. Here is a great introduction video: How to Use Commission Junction. You could also head over to Amazon.com and sign up to be an affliliate there. That one's super easy and they have a huge selection. The other option (preferred really) is that if you sell awesome Nerdy Mug type products yourself, I would love it if you would showcase your favorites here. It give me fresh content, and gives you a rooftop to shout from! The more traffic that comes to the site, the bigger chance you have of getting commissions, or straight up sales. This is where you come in as well. If you post on this site, I would love it if you would blast out the link to your post on your Facebook, Twitter, and Pinterest accounts. This helps everyone. Your friends get confirmation of how awesome you are and also get introduced to this cool site that you already know and love. And the more traffic, the more cash you can make too. Woot! So get your stuff together and get started. The simple form is in the footer. Since I have to moderate all posts right now as much info as you can include the better. If we get a working relationship going, you might even get your own login to post without moderation. Pretty sweet.
